verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Workable AI for candidate sourcing, recommendations, and screening (the Workable Agent), plus translation of job posts. None of it shows AI generating job descriptions, outreach sequences, or rejection notes, or matching a recruiter's tone. Translating existing posts and AI candidate matching are adjacent features, not AI-drafted recruiting copy, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a recruiter, AI drafts the words — job descriptions, outreach sequences, and rejection notes generated in my tone from the role's context
